text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: deploy v3.2.1 canary failing for service `inference-edge` — error_rate HTTP_5xx = 18.3% (threshold 5%). PagerDuty incident created: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/INC-20745 · region: us-west-2 · affected-traffic: canary pool

pd-bot: PagerDuty INC-20745 triggered, notifying @oncall-sre and escalations: oncall -> secondary -> eng-lead. Severity: P1. Playbook: `deploy-canary-failure`.

linh: ack. I'm on it, looking at logs and canary hosts.

jamal: oncall here. any quick mitigation possibility? if traffic is small we can shift traffic back to stable variant and rollback canary.

release-eng: I see the rollout for v3.2.1 pushed a quantized kernel change for the transformer encoder. Canary traffic split is 5%. Logs show a surge of 502s from the TFE nodes. Pulling pod logs now.

maria: CS note: partner-alpha reported sporadic 503s starting ~10:12 UTC. Roughly 0.6% of total requests hit failures, but partner-alpha accounts for ~64% of the canary traffic. Customer Impact: localized but visible on dashboards. I've DM'd partner-alpha.

oncall-sre: gathering k8s events and envoy traces. quick checks:
```bash
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=inference-edge -o wide
# pod-inference-edge-canary-1  Ready 1/1  2CPU  4GB  node-xyz
```
```bash
kubectl -n inference logs pod-inference-edge-canary-1 --since=10m | tail -n 200
# 2026-10-12T10:14:22Z ERROR runtime: kernel selection fallback failed: mismatch-size
# 2026-10-12T10:14:23Z HTTP 502 upstream read error
```

oncall-sre: reproducing a request against canary: `curl -v -H "x-model-variant: canary" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate` -> 502. Stable variant returns 200.

jamal: proposed mitigation: change traffic split to 0% canary, enable fallback routing to `stable` variant, and disable the quantized kernel path in the canary deployment if rollback can't be immediate. I'll push a traffic policy change.

release-eng: applying traffic-rebalance config now. patch: 
```yaml
apiVersion: redwood.io/v1
kind: TrafficSplit
metadata:
  name: inference-edge-split
spec:
  - variant: stable
    percent: 100
  - variant: canary
    percent: 0
```
kubectl apply -f traffic-split.yaml --namespace=inference
# traffic-split.inference-edge-split configured
```

incident-bot: TrafficSplit applied; canary traffic set to 0%. Monitoring for error rate drop.

pd-bot: PagerDuty INC-20745: acknowledged by linh. Next escalation in 12 minutes if still active.

ops-lead: good call on immediate split. Jamal, if error rate drops to baseline in next 10m, close oncall loop and create rollback-only follow-up. If not, escalate to eng-lead and start full rollback.

cs-rep: partner-alpha updated: "we see requests succeeding again, thanks" — awaiting confirmation from two more customers. No customer-impacting incidents opened.

oncall-sre: metrics update: error_rate down from 18.3% -> 1.2% over the last 8 minutes after split. Latency stable. Still watching for any resurges.

jamal: leaving note in incident timeline: temp mitigation is traffic split -> 0% canary. Next steps: reproduce locally, determine why quantized kernel path throws mismatch-size errors with longer sequences, prepare rollback package for v3.2.1 and re-run canary after fix. Assigning postmortem to release-eng@mgt.

release-eng: grep of build artifacts shows quantization tool updated on 2026-10-12 09:58 — likely the introduced kernel variant. Creating a PR to disable that optimization until validated.

incident-bot: auto-check: error_rate now 0.9% (5m avg). If stable for 30m, run resolution workflow.

oncall-sre: taking over handoff to afternoon shift in 35 minutes. leaving runbook steps and commands in the incident thread. Will escalate if any regression.

ops-lead: thanks team. tagging this P1 -> mitigated. Please file full postmortem and CI tests for quantized kernels.

jamal: closing the PD incident in 22 minutes if no further regressions. Adding `release-eng` as postmortem owner.

cs-rep: notifying impacted accounts summary: brief outage window 10:12-10:20 UTC, majority of failures internal to canary only. No SLA credits expected; will reconfirm.

oncall-sre: final check at +30m: error_rate stable at 0.5%, marking incident mitigated. Preparing to close thread after 30 more minutes of stability.

maria: adding timeline to ops-notes and creating Jira INC-20745-postmortem assigned to release-eng.

jamal: thanks — nice coordination.
